In recent years beekeepers in many countries have reported colony losses well above historical averages. Researchers point to a combination of causes: the varroa mite, pesticides such as neonicotinoids, loss of wildflower habitat and climate-driven shifts in flowering times. No single factor explains the decline, which is why conservation programmes now combine habitat restoration, restrictions on certain pesticides and breeding of mite-resistant bees.

Summarise the following in 3 sentences, then give one sentence on the main trade-off.

Microservices split an application into small, independently deployable services, each owning its data and communicating over the network. Teams can release and scale services separately, and a failure in one service need not take down the whole system. The cost is operational complexity: distributed tracing, network latency, data consistency across services and a heavier deployment pipeline. A monolith is simpler to build, test and debug, which is why many teams start there and only extract services when scaling or team size demands it.
